title: Introduce stratified throughput-delta detector with backpressure gate
author: Samir Patel
release_notes: Adds a stratified throughput regression detector that segments traffic, computes per-segment deltas, and gates canary traffic using a backpressure policy. Improves detection sensitivity for heterogeneous traffic patterns and reduces false positives during load shifts.
description: Summary: This PR implements a stratified throughput-delta detector plus a backpressure gate for rollout guards. The detector segments incoming traffic by configurable attributes (model_variant, route, client_tier) and computes per-stratum throughput deltas and confidence intervals. When one or more strata exhibit statistically significant negative throughput deltas (adjusted for expected diurnal/batch patterns), the backpressure gate reduces canary weight and triggers a pause + notification. Motivation: Current canary detectors aggregate traffic and can miss regressions that only affect a subset of users (e.g., large-batch enterprise clients) or raise false positives during traffic-shape shifts. Stratification improves signal isolation and our backpressure gate enables graceful slowdown instead of immediate rollback, reducing churn and unnecessary rollbacks for transient noise. Design and behavior: - Stratification: users can supply 1..N keys to split traffic (default: ["route", "model_variant"]). Each stratum maintains a rolling throughput time series and a sample count. - Delta computation: per-stratum delta = relative change over baseline window (median-smoothed) with bootstrap-derived confidence bounds. Deltas are normalized by stratum weight so small but high-impact strata can surface. - Aggregation policy: detector computes both per-stratum alerts and a weighted global score (L1 of significant negative deltas). The gate triggers if (A) at least one stratum crosses its per-stratum threshold AND (B) the weighted global score > configured threshold. - Backpressure gate: on trigger, canary weight is decreased in a staged manner using exponential backoff and a cooldown window. Gate exposes actions: PAUSE_CANARY, REDUCE_BY_PERCENT, and NOTIFY_ONCE. CLR (canary lifecycle) is updated to respect gate decisions and to surface rationale in the rollout timeline. - Adaptive calibration: uses historical traffic shape profiles to avoid flagging routine shifts (e.g., nightly large-batch jobs). There is a permissive mode for safe rollout into unfamiliar regions. Configuration knobs: - stratify_keys (list, default ["route","model_variant"]) - min_samples_per_stratum (int, default 50) - baseline_window and probe_window (seconds) - per_stratum_threshold (relative delta e.g., -0.15) - global_score_threshold (float) - backpressure_reduction_step (percent) - cooldown_seconds - permissive_mode (bool) Implementation notes: - New detector: perf_canary/detectors/stratified_throughput_detector.py (Python, 420 loc). - Gate: perf_canary/gates/backpressure_gate.go (Go) integrated with canary scheduler. Gate exposes a small RPC to the controller for decisioning. - Metrics ingestion: added per-stratum keys to throughput pipeline (observability/ingest) and an index in the time-series store for efficient per-stratum queries. - Tests: unit tests for delta statistics, integration test that runs a synthetic workload with a noisy large-batch stratum, and an e2e smoke test in the perf-canary harness that exercises staged weight reductions. Commits (high-level): - c1a9f2b: initial stratified detector prototype, bootstrap CI tests - d04b7e1: wire detector into canary evaluation loop, add config schema - f7e33c: implement bootstrap confidence intervals and weight-normalization - a8b21ff: implement backpressure gate in Go; add RPC + controller wiring - b3c9d10: add metrics ingestion changes and index migration script - e11c4a2: add unit/integration tests and docs - f0d5b6a: address reviewer feedback, tune thresholds, add permissive mode Changes (high level list of files changed): - perf_canary/detectors/stratified_throughput_detector.py - perf_canary/gates/backpressure_gate.go - perf_canary/controller/canary_scheduler.go - observability/ingest/ingest_pipeline.py - observability/tsdb/migrations/20251112_add_stratum_index.sql - perf_canary/tests/test_stratified_detector.py - perf_canary/tests/e2e/test_backpressure_gate.py - docs/canary/stratified-detectors.md - examples/perf/stratified-canary.yml - ci/flake_checks.yaml - Makefile (add new test targets) Small illustrative snippet (detector delta logic): "delta = (probe_median - baseline_median) / max(1.0, baseline_median); if bootstrap.pvalue(delta_samples) < alpha: mark_significant()" Review thread (high level): - Maya Chen (reviewer): "Nice isolation layer; two asks: 1) please add a safety valve so we don't continuously throttle low-volume strata, 2) justify the bootstrap sample size — it's currently 1k in tests." - Author (Samir): "Added min_samples_per_stratum guard (default 50) and doc comments explaining bootstrap sample size tradeoffs; reduced default sample size in CI to 200 to keep runtime reasonable." - Jordan Alvarez: "Can we expose the global_score as a metric and expose per-stratum deltas to the console?" - Author: "Exposed global_score and per_stratum.delta as metrics with label keys; updated docs and dashboards in a follow-up doc-only PR planned." - Priya Nandakumar: "Concern about running index migration in-prod — what's the rollout plan?" - Author: "Migration is backwards compatible: the ingest path writes an additional index but queries fall back to legacy scan during migration; step migration + monitor over 48h. Added migration runbook in docs." CI notes: - Unit tests: pass - Integration tests (local harness): one flaky e2e initially failed on timing; increased probe_window + added retries; rerun green - Static analysis/lint: pass - Benchmark: lightweight perf regression harness shows 3% CPU increase in ingest path at peak for tagging; within acceptable envelope. QA and rollout: - Canary stage: enabled for non-critical routes first (canary default weight 1%) with permissive_mode=true for 24h. - Observability: dashboards added to show per-stratum deltas, global_score, and gate state history. - Monitoring: Alert if gate reduces canary weight >50% within 10 minutes or if >3 distinct strata trigger in 1h. Follow-ups planned: - docs PR to expand operational runbook and add example Grafana panels (WIP) - add UI controls in Console to configure stratify_keys and backpressure thresholds - long-term: explore combining stratified detection with the entropy-based detector for richer signal fusion Merge and rollout: - PR merged via squash on 2025-11-20 by Maya Chen after CI green and stakeholder approval. - Post-merge, feature flagged behind perf.stratified_detector and rolled to beta accounts over one week. Notes on uniqueness and risk: This approach biases toward early detection for heterogeneous workloads and provides a softer remediation (backpressure) compared to immediate rollback—intended to reduce noisy rollbacks and allow operators to investigate. Risk area is the added index/migration and potential ingest CPU increase; mitigation is staged migration, throttled indexing, and an opt-out flag. Related work: builds on ENG-3421 (stratified-metrics proposal) and ENG-4570 (canary lifecycle hooks), and is intentionally orthogonal to the percentile-decay detectors (not a replacement).
